plan.notes: Official Georgetown University Bulletin 2026-2027, Bachelor of Arts in Psychology (major requirements only; the degree also requires general education and free electives). MATH 1040 is titled "Probability and Statistics 0" on the bulletin. The catalog publishes no official semester-by-semester sequence; requirements recorded as a single block.

courses.title: Foundational courses
courses.choice_note: Select three foundational courses: two from Area A (Developmental and Social Foundations) and one from Area B (Cognitive and Biological Foundations). Course lists are published in the Handbook for Psychology Majors, not on the bulletin page.

courses.title: Seminar courses
courses.choice_note: Select two seminar courses (list published in the Handbook for Psychology Majors)

courses.title: Combined foundational/seminar/elective courses
courses.choice_note: Select two courses from the combined offerings of foundational, seminar, and elective courses
